snippet.title: Pigs And Wolf - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now at https://store.steampowered.com/app/4285870/Pigs_and_Wolf/

Take on the roles of the iconic three little pigs who have been separated from their herd. To survive, they must use their imagination to craft, strengthen, and move their wagon home across an unpredictable fantasy world inspired by famous folklore and tales to reunite with their herd in a piggy village.

#PigsAndWolf #WakaStudio
